title: Monastery of Saint George of Choziba
scope: The standing historical masonry monastery against the north cliff of Wadi Qelt, its domed chapels, arcade and terraces, and the arched footbridge.
limitations: The cliff complex is modeled as an interpreted exterior. Relief details and elevated floor and terrace heights are approximated from the survey and period images.
The visible stone footbridge follows the mapped centerline. Other paths, caves and minor outbuildings remain outside the model.
